payload.title: M10 Documentation and README architecture diagram
payload.description:
## Outcome
Papyrus docs and the README architecture diagram describe the new picture: one CMS app (newsroom, AppSync, DynamoDB, the projection Lambda) and the projected static site (S3 behind our CloudFront), with labelled shapes, never colour alone.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md sections 2 (diagram) and 5.

## Checklist
- [ ] README two-app diagram updated: CMS app + projected site (S3/CloudFront), replacing the reader app
- [ ] docs/site-hosting.md and docs/standard-site.md updated (s3-projection default for Markus; Pretext unchanged)
- [ ] Ops runbook: project-all, reconcile, renditions --all, rollback of content and of site code

## Acceptance
- Docs reviewed by Ryan; diagram uses labelled shapes and text only.

## Out of scope
Marketing site copy.

## Dependencies
Blocked by M5 (pattern real on one site).

## Risk
Low.

## Estimate
1-2 agent-hours.
